title: L298N motor driver
prompt: an L298N dual H-bridge motor driver module wired to a DC motor and a battery: set direction, enable, the motor spins, reverse it; see-through shows the H-bridge transistors in the chip, heat sink, diodes, regulator and screw terminals
blurb: Set the direction and PWM duty, enable a DC motor, then reverse or brake it while seeing the L298N H-bridge at work.
